```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ineq, tidyplots,DT)

gini_index <- function(counts) {
  n <- length(counts)
  mean_count <- mean(counts)
  sum_abs_diff <- sum(sapply(counts, function(x) sum(abs(x - counts))))
  gini <- sum_abs_diff / (2 * n^2 * mean_count)
  return(gini)
}

htlv_is = read_tsv("concatenated_clonality.txt", col_names = c("range", "chrom", "start", "end", "freq", "freq_p", "sample"))
htlv_is
# Option A for gini index
result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(gini = Gini(freq), .groups = 'drop') |>
  filter(gini>0.4) # filtering those with high oligoclonality

# Option B
result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  group_split() |>
  map_dfr(~ tibble(sample = .x$sample[1], 
    gini = Gini(.x$freq),
    sum_freq = sum(.x$freq))) 

# Plotting
result |>
tidyplot(x=gini, y=sum_freq) |>
add_data_points(alpha=0.8) |>
adjust_x_axis(title = "Oligoclonality Index (OCI)") |>
adjust_y_axis(title = "Integration Sites (IS) \nNGS Abundance") |>
save_plot("output/oci.png", 
  view_plot = TRUE,
  bg = "transparent",
  width = 7,
  height = 7, 
  unit="cm")


datatable(result)
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, midasHLA, styler, lintr, DT)

# Step1: Filtering data, removing those without HTLV-1 clones or reads, and JP cases
htlv_la = read_tsv("concatenated_HLA.txt", col_names = c("none", "A_1", "A_2", "B_1", "B_2", "C_1", "C_2", "none_reads", "none_obj", "ID"))|>
  select(-starts_with("none")) |>
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("ATLSkin|1339|IRID011|IRID038", ID)) |>
  select(ID, A_1, A_2, B_1, B_2, C_1, C_2) #|>
  filter(ID%in%c(htlv_clonality$ID)) #Those withoyt transitory PVL

datatable(htlv_la) #visualization
write_tsv(htlv_la, "2503_filtered_HLA_rearranged.tsv")

# Step2: match duplicates (see text)
sample = htlv_la |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    group1 = list(sort(c(A_1, A_2))),  
    group2 = list(sort(c(B_1, B_2))),  
    group3 = list(sort(c(C_1, C_2)))   
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    is_duplicate = duplicated(paste(group1, group2, group3)) |  duplicated(paste(group1, group2, group3), fromLast = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(is_duplicate=="TRUE")
datatable(sample)


htlv_la = htlv_la |>
  left_join(result[c("sample", "gini", "sum_freq")], by=c("ID"="sample"))

htlv_clonality= htlv_la |>
  select(ID, gini, sum_freq) |>
  filter(!is.na(gini))

htlv_clonality
# Step2: read using midasHLA
hla_htlv = reduceHlaCalls(htlv_la, resolution=4)

midas <- prepareMiDAS(
  hla_calls = hla_htlv,
  colData = htlv_clonality,
  experiment = "hla_alleles")

freq <- getFrequencies(
  object = midas,
  carrier_frequency = FALSE,
  experiment = "hla_alleles",
  compare = TRUE
)
freq |>
  filter(Counts>10)
midas_filtered_freq <-
  filterByFrequency(
    object = midas,
    experiment = "hla_alleles",
    lower_frequency_cutoff = 0.01
    )
midas_filtered_freq


object<-lm(gini~term, data=midas)
results <-
  runMiDAS(
    object = object,
    experiment = "hla_alleles",
    inheritance_model = "dominant",
    conditional = FALSE,
    omnibus = FALSE,
    lower_frequency_cutoff = 0.05
    )
kableResults(results)

htlv_clonality
results |>
  filter(p.value<0.05)
```
